concept: Review and integration: sustainable, clear-eyed compassion as a lifelong practice
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any external text

exercise.reflection_prompt: Across sustainable caregiving, compassion without endorsement, and compassionate leadership — what's your personal throughline?
exercise.practice: Adult writes a short personal statement on what compassion means to them in practice

assessment.success_marker: adult produces a personal statement referencing at least two of the three adult-stage scenarios
